text: One scorching afternoon, an old carved calabash slipped from Kumba's tired hands into the river mud.
When her stepmother saw the smudge, she flew into a rage.
'Take this calabash,' the stepmother hissed, 'and walk until you find the mythical Sea of Daayaan!
Do not show your face in this village again until the waters have washed it as pure as milk.'
With a heavy heart but without a word of anger, gentle Kumba tied her headwrap, took the bowl, and walked out into the vast, shimmering savanna.
